Title: Zul'jin Balance Patch
Subtitle: Balance Update
CleanedNotes:
=== Heroes: Azmodan ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Can no longer mount while channeling All Shall Burn.

=== Heroes: Dehaka ===
[Updates]
  Talents:
  • Level 1
    • Primal Aggression (W)
      • Bonus damage to Minions and Mercenaries reduced from 100 to 90%
  • Level 7
    • Symbiosis (W)
      • Cooldown reduction per Hero hit decreased from 0.5 to 0.4 seconds
  • Level 13
    • Primal Swarm (W)
      • Armor reduction after being hit by Dark Swarm decreased from -15 to -10
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that caused Dark Swarm to deal more damage than intended to Minions, and Mercenaries after learning Primal Aggression.
  • Fixed an issue that caused Dark Swarm to deal bonus damage to Monsters after learning Primal Aggression.
